/**
 * Write a function to calculate the sum of the positive integers of n+(n-2)+(n-4)... (until n-x =< 0).
 * > sumSeries(6)
 * 12
 * > sumSeries(10)
 * 30
 * > sumSeries(9)
 * 25
 */
int sumSeries(int n) {
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = n; i > 0; i -= 2) {
        sum += i;
    }
    return sum;
}


int main() {
    cout << sumSeries(6) << endl;
    cout << sumSeries(10) << endl;
    cout << sumSeries(9) << endl;
    return 0;
}

/**
 * Write a c++ function to check whether all the bits are unset in the given range or not.
 * > allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(4, 1, 2)
 * true
 * > allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(17, 2, 4)
 * true
 * > allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(39, 4, 6)
 * false
 */
bool allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(int n, int l, int r) {
    int mask = (1 << (r - l + 1)) - 1;
    return (n & mask) == mask;
}


int main() {
    cout << allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(4, 1, 2) << endl;
    cout << allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(17, 2, 4) << endl;
    cout << allBitsSetInTheGivenRange(39, 4, 6) << endl;
    return 0;
}

/**
 * Write a c++ function to count number of non-empty substrings of a given string.
 * > numberOfSubstrings(string("abc"))
 * 6
 * > numberOfSubstrings(string("abcd"))
 * 10
 * > numberOfSubstrings(string("abcde"))
 * 15
 */
int numberOfSubstrings(string str) {
    int n = str.length();
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

    cout << numberOfSubstrings(string("abc")) << endl;
    cout << numberOfSubstrings(string("abcd")) << endl;
    cout << numberOfSubstrings(string("abcde")) << endl;
    return 0;
}

/**
 * Write a c++ function to find the most significant bit number which is also a set bit.
 * > setBitNumber(6)
 * 4
 * > setBitNumber(10)
 * 8
 * > setBitNumber(18)
 * 16
 */
int setBitNumber(int n) {
    int msb = 0;
    while (n) {
        msb++;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return msb;
}

    cout << setBitNumber(6) << endl;
    cout << setBitNumber(10) << endl;
    cout << setBitNumber(18) << endl;

/**
 * Write a function to find t-nth term of arithemetic progression.
 * > tnAp(1, 5, 2)
 * 9
 * > tnAp(2, 6, 4)
 * 22
 * > tnAp(1, 4, 5)
 * 16
 */
int tnAp(int a, int n, int d) {
    return a + (n - 1) * d;
}
